what_happened: Scene layout/style 9: double black basin, tall pull-down faucet with a spring neck; the on/off handle is a round hub with a red dot and a lever hanging down on the side of the base (same faucet as s0, s2, s3, s18, s20, s26). Stage 0: first approach 92-116, the lever hangs down to the upper-left of the finger gap; the gripper closed at 104 to width 0.014 beside the lever (touch 104-112), the lever tilted only 0.025 rad; the arm moved away 124-160 (wrist sees the window). Second approach 236-268: closed again at 268 to 0.009 at/next to the lever (touch 247-259), handle still ~0.03. From 288 the gripper stayed closed and the arm hovered 10-25 cm from the handle for ~450 steps (300-740) with the lever in the wrist view, approaching and backing off (close at 420/580, farther at 468/700) without touching. 744-784 it pushed the faucet stem (spout to -0.19) with the water off, then hovered near the handle again to 900. Water never ran.
causal_chain: two closes beside the lever (104 -> 0.014, 268 -> 0.009) moved it only 0.03 rad -> gripper left closed, hovered at the handle 288-740 without another real attempt -> pushed the spout with water off 744-784 -> stage 0 never complete at 900
self_recovery: One re-approach at 236-268 (also missed). After that, approach/retreat cycles near the handle but no further contact with the lever. Not successful.
uncertain_about: Exactly where the fingers were relative to the lever at the two closes; 4-step wrist frames show the lever just outside the finger gap but the contact geometry is not fully resolvable.
